verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.morphllm.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with API base-URL and usage guidance). Doc pages are also served as raw markdown (.md) and point agents to the llms.txt index, so an agent can be aimed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or first-party docs describing agent-doc usage, and no independent user corroboration.
